disclaimer.text: This tool provides a preliminary risk estimate based on statistical patterns. It is not a medical diagnosis. Please consult a qualified healthcare professional for any concerns, especially if your result is Moderate or High risk.
profile.title: Profile
about.title: About This Model
about.subtitle: Transparency on what powers your risk estimate, and its limits.
about.datasetText: The risk model is designed to be trained on the Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset schema: eight clinical measurements (pregnancies, glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin, BMI, diabetes pedigree function, and age) used to estimate the likelihood of a diabetes-related outcome.
about.statusText: The prediction and report-scanning services in this build are currently backed by clearly-marked mock implementations so the full product experience can be evaluated end-to-end. They are designed as drop-in replacements: a trained model will be swapped in without any change to the rest of the app.
about.lim1: The original dataset's population may not generalize across all ethnicities, geographies, or age groups.
about.lim2: Reference ranges shown are general population guidance, not individualized clinical thresholds.
about.lim3: Report-scanning accuracy depends on image quality and printout format.
about.lim4: This tool has not been validated as a clinical-grade diagnostic device.
about.intendedText: DiaCare is intended as a first-line self-screening aid to prompt a conversation with a qualified healthcare professional -- not as a replacement for clinical diagnostics, laboratory testing, or medical advice.
